choice.rationale: Under frozen 5s median @ 0.95/0.85, attack sessions already show 0 window-level REAL. Continuity gates do not further reduce false REAL; they mainly map high NO_FACE/MULTI windows from SPOOF/UNCERTAIN → INVALID (decision hygiene) with little genuine AR loss on mild settings. That is not enough to change the frozen PAD candidate. Keep baseline continuity; optionally study min_face_ok_coverage_0.50 as a separate hygiene candidate (would need fresh validation if chosen using SCREEN2 patterns).
choice.safety_vs_rejection: Added continuity primarily increases INVALID (lost-coverage / interruption) rather than cutting false REAL; genuine rejection rise is small for cov>=0.50 / loss<=1.0s (0pp on pooled REAL2+REAL3) but cov>=0.60 costs 1 REAL window on REAL3.

what_logs_cannot_establish: Same-face continuous tracking / track ID persistence
That FACE_OK→FACE_OK implies uninterrupted single-subject presence
what_logs_can_establish: Wall-clock spans of consecutive face-loss decisions
FACE_OK coverage fraction within a 5s window
Usable FasNet score counts (PAD evidence density)

policy_note: Offline research only. Continuity gates never create REAL. Correlated windows ≠ independent attacks. Live auth unchanged.
